bundlingNotes: Premium-only rate manual; no settlement/closing/escrow dollar figures anywhere in the Basic Schedule of Charges. NOTABLE DATA-INTEGRITY ANOMALY: this manual has an appended 'SCHEDULE A - Special Products Available for Stewart Title Guaranty Company Issuance in Indiana' section (a Centralized Processing Loan and Refinance Rate table and an STG HELP home equity policy table, both explicitly labeled for Indiana). This is an apparent copy-paste/mislabeling error carried over from Stewart's Indiana manual template -- it is NOT North Dakota-specific and has been excluded from this evidence file. It mirrors a similar copy-paste error found in an FNTI Michigan manual (which contained an appended 'Alabama' schedule) in an earlier survey session.
